_readme: All tunable numbers for the replay harness. Policy rules (caps, windows, holds) are NOT here - they are read from policy/k01_policy.json and policy/k21_scorecard.json (Ojas). Values marked ASSUMPTION need confirmation.
baseline_source: dev stand-in (config.json baseline.cadence) - official fixed-cadence file pending K02
run_label: SIMULATED - dev fallback (PL_Dummy_Collections_Data_500 scaled to 50K; dev simulator, not the official CM-02 simulator)

collection_target._note: ASSUMPTION: K01 marks these REQUIRED_INPUT. Ask Ojas for real values. Set high so the dev run covers the full window.

band_mix._note: The 500-loan file is 100% DPD 1-30. To exercise every K01 band we keep 60% at source DPD and shift the rest. Every row records dpd_source.

channel_cost_inr._note: sms/whatsapp/email/ivr from K01 test cases (est_cost_inr). voicebot is an ASSUMPTION. Replace with D10 when it arrives.

baseline._note: ASSUMPTION: dev stand-in for the official fixed-cadence policy file. Swap in the official file when K02 clears.
